recent_en: The company announced its half-year results for the period ended 30 September 2026 in November 2026. It earlier declared a single-tier interim dividend of 0.15 sen per share, with ex-date on 21 October 2026 and payment date on 28 October 2026. The company also completed a private placement of up to 66,855,300 new shares, with several substantial shareholder interest change filings.
notable_en: Declared a single-tier interim dividend of 0.15 sen per share, ex-date 21 October 2026, payment date 28 October 2026.
Completed a private placement of up to 66,855,300 new shares at an issue price of RM0.018 per share.
The 8th Annual General Meeting was held on 18 September 2026 and all resolutions were passed.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 66,855,300 new shares, representing approximately 23.1% of the enlarged share capital, may dilute existing shareholders' interests.
Substantial shareholders Chin Wing Wah and Netton Resources Sdn. Bhd. made several interest change filings between October and November 2026.
